senses.gloss: (sec. r. of אוס, v. אנס; cmp. יש, איש, אינש &c.; v. Ges. H. Dict. s. vv. אשׁה, עשׂה) to be strong, well. [Act. v. to make well, v. infra a. אָסֵי.]

units: Targ. O. Gen. XX, 17 (Targ. Y. אָסֵי); a. fr.—Part. מַסֵּי, מְאַסֵּי.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 111a:4">Sabb. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>איכא מכה מסי</he> where there is a wound, it (the vinegar) heals it.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:3">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>, end, read: <he>מְאַסִּינָא ליה לגרמי</he> I shall cure him all alone.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 5:8">Targ. Josh. V, 8</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 12b:12">Gitt. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>דבעי אִתְּסוּיֵי ביה</he> for he wants to get cured with the money he receives as damages.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:8">Koh. R. to I, 8</cite> he went &c. <he>מִיתְאַסְּיָא</he> in order to be cured. Cmp. <cite ref="F00066"><he>וֶסֶת</he></cite>.
